text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean, consistent, and easy to maintain. Although code reviews take extra time, they are a valuable investment. Teams that review code carefully usually produce more reliable software and work better together.
